lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-intensity circular spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank. Each column contains 3-4 primary centroids with a uniform vertical distribution and increasing horizontal spacing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint but discernible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a rectangular grid pattern across the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper and middle third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light-colored top edge to a shadowed lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct orange-pigmented circular mark is visible on the lateral flank, positioned posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
